successors.name: Nanda Empire
successors.text: the Magadhan empire of the Nandas, which absorbed the Gangetic janapadas: 'The Nandas usurped the throne of Shishunaga dynasty c.

successors.name: Achaemenid Empire
successors.text: 'Kamboja and Gandhara formed the twentieth and richest satrapy of the Achaemenid Empire'

ledger.x: 600 BCE: the sixteen Mahajanapadas stand in the Iron Age north.
345 BCE: the Nandas take the Magadhan throne and the old order ends.

wars.name: Ajatashatru's war on the Vajjika League
wars.outcome: Magadha won: Ajātasattu 'declared war on the Vajjika League in 484 BCE' and needed diplomacy and intrigue 'to finally defeat the Vajjika League by 468 BCE and annex its territories'; the Mallakas also became part of his empire with limited autonomy.

certainty.note: An association of sixteen states with no frontier of its own; each member's border is soft and is judged in its own dossier.
